title: What Games Are Like For Someone Who Doesn't Play Games
summary: Razbuten has his wife, who has never played games, try a sampling of titles and shows where she struggles. It highlights unspoken game conventions that experienced players take for granted.
why: HN uses it to illustrate learned literacy in game and software UX, and how unfamiliar conventions confuse newcomers.

quote.text: The video has a bunch of other interesting observations.
